messages.subject: Thank you for shiny
parts:
For the Open Data Hackathon (local organization in Senegal) I decided to build a small web apps to scrapp some open data.
In 3hrs or less  I was able to build from scratch a small apps using shiny and I'm really impressed by the design and ease to use.
This is my first app and I know there is a lot of caveat and there is a lot of things I have to understand in shiny to build better app.

I just want to thanks to Shiny-developpers (Joe, Winston et al) and all people in this mailing list.
I'll continue to work on this to improve this app.

Here is the link for the app.

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/dickoa/OpenDataApp/

https://github.com/dickoa/OpenDataApp.git
